statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
These episodes are unexplained by standard evaluation
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service billed is CPT code 93247 (long-term continuous ECG monitoring study)
The diagnosis codes submitted are R55 and I34.0
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the requested service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
